algorithm.name: Quality Wins
algorithm.description: Ranks players by the average quality of their eligible wins (1 - Expected Score). Higher scores indicate more impressive wins relative to pre-match expectations.
algorithm.limitations: Evaluates average win quality rather than total victory volume or overall win rate.

parameters.formula: Average Quality per Win = Sum of (1 - Expected Score) / Number of Eligible Wins
parameters.expectedScoreFormula: Glicko-2 E(mu_winner, mu_loser, phi_loser) using pre-match ratings
